stemMd: A shop sells 30% of its initial stock, then receives 45 more units. It now has 150 units. How many units were initially in stock?
explanationMd: After removing the delivery, 105 units remain from the original stock. They represent 70% of the initial amount, so initial stock is 105/0.70=150.

distractorRationale.e: This ignores the restocking before reversing the percentage.
distractorRationale.b: This does not satisfy the stock balance.
distractorRationale.d: This adds the delivery to the final stock.
distractorRationale.a: This is the stock after the sale and before restocking.
